日本には古来より「わび」「さび」という日本独特の文化の伝承があり、それは西洋のような「幾何学」や「力」の美とは異なる
「小さい」、「清らか」というものに美を感じる文化が脈々とあると思います。
もちろん戦後の西洋化により現在の日本人の美への意識もかなり変わってきているとは思いますが、
日本の古来より残る優れた作品がある限り生き続けていけると思います。
日本の美の文化をご紹介します。
There is tradition of the culture more peculiar to Japan called "austere refinement" "rust" than ancient
times in Japan, and, as for it, "it is small" which is different from the beauty of "geometry" and "the power" such as the
West thinks that culture to feel the beauty to a thing to "be clean" is unbroken.
Of course I think that the consciousness to the current beauty of Japanese people considerably changes by postwar westernization,
but think that I can continue growing as far as there is a superior work to remain from Japanese ancient times.
I introduce culture of the beauty of Japan.
